item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 05/Sep/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Yagi will move across the northern part of the South China Sea today and tomorrow, moving in the general direction of the vicinity of Leizhou Peninsula to Hainan Island. Under its influence, it will be windy with heavy squally showers and thunderstorms over the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. Seas will be very rough with swells. With Yagi departing and weakening, showers will ease off gradually over the coast of Guangdong early next week. Meanwhile, a broad area of low pressure is expected to affect the seas east of Taiwan. A broad trough of low pressure will bring showers to the central and northern parts of the South China Sea midweek next week.
